models.name: AREX-2
models.notes: BAAI fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B; 27B is the published nominal total. Publisher repository BAAI/AREX-2 is public, Apache-2.0, and contains 11 safetensors shards (27.3567B serialized parameters). The official research profile reuses this policy for page summaries; external judges only score benchmark answers.

models.name: Traverse-35B
models.notes: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-based trained search policy; 35B nominal total determines Small, with 3B active per token. The official runtime repository is public but separates policy weights from the harness. No exact evaluated checkpoint inventory was located; weights remain uncertain. The evaluated system also has a separate page-summary tool whose backbone is undisclosed.

models.name: Traverse page-summary backend (undisclosed)
models.notes: Paper Appendix F.1.2 supplies question-conditioned synthesized page answers and permits a reader-plus-LLM fallback. The public runtime delegates link_summary_tool to a deployment-specific callable and does not identify its evaluated backbone, parameters, or token rate. Medium is a provisional estimate for this bounded summarization role, consistent with other unresolved research summarizers; its actual size and whether it reuses the actor remain unknown. No parameter count is invented.

models.notes: NVIDIA publishes 74B total / 9B active parameters. Full-precision BF16 checkpoint. Open weights under the OpenMDW License Agreement v1.1.

submissions.notes: Released 27B fine-tuned policy and public evaluation harness verified. Research-profile page summaries reuse the inference policy. The paper’s BrowseComp process uses self-confidence rather than correctness feedback; external scoring judges and training teachers are excluded from the runtime model stack.

Full BrowseComp score is 72.83% (Table 1 rounds to 72.8); the 185-question BC-185 subset is used only for ablations. Actor is a trained Qwen3.5-35B-A3B policy with unverified checkpoint availability. Runtime link_summary_tool returns synthesized page answers through an undisclosed deployment backend, so this stack includes a provisional Medium summarizer and remains uncertain. Memory sealing and self-verification use the actor; external benchmark judges and training teachers are excluded.
